Subject: Re: Redwood trial for Novapulse prototype

Hi Avery,

Quick update from our side — the PO is sitting in finance routing and has hit a couple of approvals (legal sign-off took longer than expected). Procurement says it should be fully routed in about 7–10 business days, but they couldn't guarantee an exact date.

We're mid-demo with the product team and losing access would slow the prototype momentum. Is there a way to keep our sandbox active while the PO works its way through approvals? If possible, we'd need about two weeks of access and a short note we can attach to the PO file that outlines any temporary terms.

I can loop in our procurement lead if that helps.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Program Manager, Novapulse
emily.zhao@novapulse.ai
p: (415) 555-0123

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial for Novapulse prototype

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. Really glad the demo is progressing.

We can absolutely help preserve the prototype momentum while your PO clears. Here's what I can offer from our side:

- 14 calendar days of sandbox access extension starting immediately (no charge).
- A one-time 7,500 token credit applied to your project to cover heavier test runs.
- A short written confirmation note (PDF) stating the extension and credits, which you can attach to the PO for your auditors.

Please confirm the email address for your procurement lead if you'd like me to include them in the note, and whether we should start the extension today.

Also copying Ben (enterprise sales) and Grace (CS) so we have the right approvals and instrumentation on our side.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Cell: (650) 555-0198

Attachment: trial-credit-summary.csv (text/csv)

Thanks Avery — that would be fantastic and should keep us on track. Please start the extension today.

For procurement documentation: please address the short confirmation note to "Novapulse Procurement" and include these points: the extension period (dates), the exact credit amount, and a statement that no additional billing will occur while the PO is in routing. Our procurement lead (copied) will attach it to the PO.

Procurement, meet Avery Johnson at Redwood — Avery will provide a temporary-access confirmation for the PO.

Appreciate the quick help — Emily
